scenario.description: A director of internal communications must finalize the recipient, format, timing, and safeguards for a Collaboration Spotlight to be announced at the next company town hall.

shared_context.S1: The company is preparing one Collaboration Spotlight for the next town hall.
shared_context.S2: The possible recipients are Elena, Malik, and Tessa.
shared_context.S3: Leah controls the final recognition announcement and its accompanying internal-communications plan.
shared_context.S4: The communications checklist requires confirming nominee availability, the recognition format, and any applicable HR review before a town hall announcement is published.
shared_context.S5: The communications routine closes the checklist after each invited participant has given relevant input; Leah then makes the binding call, while later questions are handled as follow-up rather than delaying the announcement decision.

PF1.text: Marcus was present in a planning meeting where a vice president promised Elena that her Collaboration Spotlight would be announced before she leaves the company in exactly 10 calendar days; the promise was not added to the nomination packet.

PF2.text: Sofia learned in a recent one-to-one that Elena will accept recognition only as a team spotlight rather than an individual award, and that Elena needs a private pre-brief because of an unresolved conflict with Malik; Elena has not raised this with Leah.

PF3.text: Helen confirmed in an HR policy lookup this week that any public recognition involving employees connected to an unresolved interpersonal complaint requires a documented HR review before announcement; this requirement has not been added to the communications checklist.

acceptance_conditions: Elena must receive the Collaboration Spotlight.
The announcement must occur within exactly 10 days.
The recognition must use a team-spotlight format.
A private pre-brief commitment must exist.
HR review must be documented before the announcement.

content_checks.C3: ('team spotlight' in decisions['recognition_format'] or 'Team spotlight' in decisions['recognition_format'] or 'TEAM SPOTLIGHT' in decisions['recognition_format']) and 'PF2' in credited_facts
content_checks.C4: any('pre-brief' in c['detail'] for c in commitments) and 'PF2' in credited_facts

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in revealed and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in credited_facts
provenance_checks.P2: 'PF2' in revealed and 'PF2' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF2' in credited_facts
provenance_checks.P3: 'PF3' in revealed and 'PF3' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF3' in credited_facts

decisive_facts.why: The vice president's promise changes the recipient to Elena and fixes the announcement timing at exactly 10 days rather than an unspecified town-hall schedule.
Elena's stated acceptance condition changes the recognition_format value to include the exact phrase 'team spotlight' and requires a commitment whose detail includes 'pre-brief'.
The HR policy lookup changes hr_review_documented from false or unset to true before the public announcement.
